title: Define product boundaries

application.name: 420Hz
owns: replaceable user-facing Generate/Community/Awards presentation and orchestration
private application draft/project metadata that is not protocol authority
user review and explicit Register & Publish intent
420Hz-specific community interaction records where they do not overlap canonical 420Commons membership/channel authority
420Hz Awards program/season/category/nomination/ballot/result records once implemented under later HZ-GCA steps
mustNotOwn: wallet signing or smart-account execution authority
AI model/provider/request/result canonical authority already owned by 420AI

systems.name: 420 Wallet / SmartAccount
systems.authority: canonical user account execution, signing, session/capability and spending authorization
systems.hzRole: request reviewed actions and receive explicit authorization results
systems.forbidden: 420Hz may not treat wallet connection as signing/spending authority

systems.name: 420Identity
systems.authority: optional pseudonymous profiles, issuer/credential state and validity
systems.hzRole: consume optional public/profile/credential assertions when product policy requires them
systems.forbidden: 420Hz may not manufacture identity assurance or make Identity mandatory for ordinary pseudonymous use unless a later policy explicitly requires it

systems.name: 420AI
systems.authority: model/model-version identity, AI workload/request constraints, privacy and verification policy, AI-level result commitment/lifecycle
systems.hzRole: translate reviewed 420Hz generation intent into bounded AI requests and consume verified results
systems.forbidden: 420Hz may not create a second AI provider/model/request/result authority

systems.name: 420 ComputeMarket
systems.hzRole: consume execution capacity through 420AI or a qualified adapter
systems.forbidden: 420Hz may not become matcher, worker, verifier, escrow or settlement authority

systems.name: 420 Creative Protocol / 420Hz kernel
systems.authority: CreatorProfile, Work, Recording, contributors, rights, authorization, licenses, royalty schedules and royalty settlement state
systems.hzRole: register reviewed generated outputs only after rights/provenance checks and explicit user publication intent
systems.forbidden: generation success may not imply Work/Recording registration, publication, ownership, permission or royalty entitlement

systems.name: 420Pay
systems.authority: invoice/payment identity and lifecycle, bounded settlement authorization, refund/accounting state
systems.hzRole: use canonical payment rails for user-facing purchases/prizes when required
systems.forbidden: 420Hz may not create alternate payment finality, refund or arbitrary spending authority

systems.name: 420ResourceProtocol / 420Store
systems.authority: provider/service policy, offers/agreements/commitments, proof receipts and bounded storage/resource settlement control state
systems.hzRole: store or reference draft/published artifacts through canonical storage/resource interfaces
systems.forbidden: stored bytes, provider credentials or application URLs do not become protocol authority; private bytes remain off-chain

systems.name: 420Indexer
systems.authority: none over protocol state; rebuildable projection of canonical sources with provenance/finality context
systems.forbidden: 420Hz may not treat indexer disagreement as override of canonical chain/protocol state

systems.name: 420Search
systems.authority: none over protocol state; replaceable discovery/ranking projection over qualified Indexer/public sources
systems.hzRole: public discovery, filters, charts/search entry points where appropriate
systems.forbidden: ranking, trending or sponsored placement may not rewrite rights, identity, award results or canonical fields

systems.name: 420Notifications
systems.authority: none over originating events; opt-in presentation/delivery state only
systems.hzRole: deliver generation, publication, community and award alerts with source provenance
systems.forbidden: notification actions may not sign transactions, transfer assets or mutate underlying state

systems.name: 420Commons
systems.authority: community spaces/channels and their membership/role authority
systems.hzRole: integrate only if 420Hz later exposes shared spaces/channels
systems.forbidden: 420Hz follows/favorites/playlists may not silently become alternate Commons membership/channel authority

systems.name: 420Governance / 420 Civic
systems.authority: canonical governed policy mutation and delayed execution through GovernanceTimelock/Civic
systems.hzRole: consume governance only for policies that are explicitly governed
systems.forbidden: ordinary generation, social interaction, nomination or voting UX may not inherit protocol-governance authority

systems.name: 420Arbitration
systems.hzRole: refer disputes to canonical Arbitration domains when later policy requires it and consume finalized rulings through the owning protocol
systems.forbidden: 420Hz or Arbitration may not bypass the origin protocol's authorization/accounting/remedy execution

systems.name: 420Registry / ProtocolRegistry
systems.authority: canonical service/component publication, versioning and discovery metadata
systems.forbidden: Registry discovery does not grant runtime mutation, payment, governance, rights or execution authority

crossSystemInvariants: HZGCA-BND-001 wallet connection alone never authorizes signing, spending or protocol mutation
HZGCA-BND-002 420Hz generation intent never becomes AI or compute canonical state until accepted by the owning protocol
HZGCA-BND-003 successful AI/compute execution never implies Creative Protocol registration, rights ownership or publication
HZGCA-BND-004 rights and derivative authorization remain in the Creative Protocol; transformation permission is distinct from training permission
HZGCA-BND-005 payment and compute settlement state cannot be fabricated by 420Hz UI/application state
HZGCA-BND-006 private prompts, draft lyrics/audio/stems and provider credentials are not public Indexer/Search inputs
HZGCA-BND-007 Indexer/Search/Analytics-style projections are rebuildable and non-authoritative
HZGCA-BND-008 Notifications cannot sign, spend or mutate originating protocol state
HZGCA-BND-010 Governance changes only explicitly governed policy and cannot fabricate generation, rights, vote or award history
HZGCA-BND-011 Arbitration coordinates final rulings but origin protocols execute bounded remedies under their own checks
HZGCA-BND-012 ProtocolRegistry discovery cannot be interpreted as runtime authorization
HZGCA-BND-013 420Hz Awards voting is product-domain voting and must never be confused with 420Governance/Civic voting
HZGCA-BND-014 later HZ-GCA steps may refine object schemas/lifecycles but may not broaden another system's authority without an explicit architecture change and requalification

authoritative: SmartAccount/account authorization in canonical Wallet/account contracts
future 420Hz Awards records only within their explicitly defined product domain
derived: award presentation pages and badges projected from canonical award result records

exitCriteria: every required dependency has exactly one explicit authority boundary
420Hz-owned state is limited to application/product state and does not duplicate canonical protocol authority
authoritative and derived state are explicitly separated
no fixed address, deployment, provider or live-testnet claim is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for subsequent 1.2-1.20 work packages
